start: Workout started on the phone; MettleUp open on the watch; notifications allowed

steps.action: Look at the watch face and the notifications
user_sees: A notice 'Workout in progress' 'Tap to open MettleUp'
A MettleUp icon on the watch face
must_not: A sound or buzz from the notice

steps.action: Lower the wrist between sets for a few minutes
user_sees: MettleUp stays up (dimmed), not the watch face
must_not: The watch face replacing MettleUp mid-workout

steps.action: Finish the workout on the phone
user_sees: The notice and the icon are gone
must_not: The notice staying after the workout

start: Workout open; the member is on the watch face or in another app

steps.action: Tap the MettleUp icon on the watch face, or the notice
user_sees: MettleUp opens on the current set
must_not: A second copy of MettleUp
The 'Start a workout' screen during a workout

start: Notifications refused on the watch ('Not now' on Rest alerts), or heart rate refused on Android 14+

steps.action: Start a workout on the phone and lower the wrist
user_sees: No notice (notifications off), or the notice alone without the keep-alive (heart rate off); the app still opens
must_not: A crash
An error on the watch

steps.action: Discard the workout on the phone
user_sees: The notice and icon are gone
must_not: The notice left behind

steps.action: Start a new workout
user_sees: The notice back
must_not: Two notices

start: Workout open; someone else looks at the member's watch face

steps.action: Look at the watch face
user_sees: Only 'Workout in progress' and the icon
must_not: Exercise names, weights or heart rate on the watch face notice

start: Workout open; the phone dies or loses MettleUp and never sends 'ended'

steps.action: 4 hours pass with no word from the phone
user_sees: (No screen) the service stops and the notice times out; the watch shows 'Start a workout on your phone'
must_not: The notice kept forever
The old set shown for good

start: Workout open; MettleUp comes back to the front after a call

steps.action: Screen up again
user_sees: (No screen) the notice is posted again and the keep-alive started
must_not: The watch face taking over later because the notice was lost

start: MettleUp in the background when the phone's workout message arrives

steps.action: Message arrives
user_sees: (No screen) the notice is posted; the keep-alive is not started from the background
must_not: A crash from a refused background start

steps.action: Workout ends on the phone
user_sees: (No screen) keep-alive stopped and the notice removed
must_not: The keep-alive left running after the workout

steps.action: The system kills the keep-alive while the workout is open
user_sees: (No screen) the notice stays without it
must_not: The notice removed while the workout is still open

user_sees: A notice 'Workout in progress' 'Tap to open MettleUp'

steps.action: On the old version, do ""Workout in progress" notice for the whole workout" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
